operations.body: All nine fibers across three primes are affine-consistent. At maximal observed rank 1152, the stacked radial-boundary matrix has full rank 1921; its restriction to the 769-dimensional affine kernel has rank 769, and the inhomogeneous boundary-kernel system is inconsistent. Characteristic-zero reconstruction remains pending.
